description: This file defines the 'AccountingRule' entity class for the Fineract accounting module. It manages accounting rules, including properties like name, associated office, debit and credit accounts, description, and tagging rules. It also provides methods for creating, updating, and managing tax rules and tags associated with accounting entries.

classes.name: AccountingRule
classes.description: Represents an accounting rule entity that links accounting policy configurations with accounts, office, and associated tags. It supports creation, updating, and tag management functionalities within the accounting context.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a new AccountingRule instance from JSON input, associated office, debit and credit accounts, and configuration flags.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the properties of an existing AccountingRule based on JSON command input and tracks changes.

methods.name: updateAccountingRuleForTags
methods.description: Associates a list of AccountingTagRules with this AccountingRule.

methods.name: updateTags
methods.description: Filters and retains tags based on the JournalEntryType (credit or debit).

methods.name: getAccountingTagRulesByType
methods.description: Returns the set of tags associated with the specified JournalEntryType.

methods.name: removeOldTags
methods.description: Removes specified tags from the accounting rule.
